description: The people and addresses a company's own website lists (team, about, contact and press pages, a page's author), read live and ranked for your `objective`, each paired with an email: a published address checked at the mailbox, or a found one (the email_find patterns). Returns `contacts` (name, role, role_fit, email, email_method published | pattern_verified | catch_all_guess | none, verification, fingerprint, source_url, evidence), `pages` read and `status` (ok, no_contacts, unreadable, robots_disallowed). Honours robots.txt, reads at most 8 pages. Costs $0.009 per contact returned with a usable address; names without an address, catch-all guesses, dead addresses and empty sites are free. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

company_id.description: Your own id for the company, echoed back in `key`.

domain.description: The company's domain (example.com) or an https URL on it; a URL's own author ranks first.

max_finds.description: How many top people with no published address get an email find. Default 2. Any number: up to 4 run now, the rest are queued (status queued, job_id) and billed per contact found when the job delivers.

objective.description: Who counts as the right person. Default sales.

verify_published.description: Check each published address at the mailbox. Default true.

name: website_contacts
title: Find Website Contacts
